beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: That combination of conceptual analysis and implementation detail distinguishes the book from a naming exercise.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: A language model can propose the translation into this controlled layer.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: The proposal must preserve source spans, unresolved references, alternatives, and introduced assumptions.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: Deterministic checks then inspect structure, types, contexts, and required provenance.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: Passing those checks still does not establish that the translation means what the source meant.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: The book therefore adds contrastive tests, rendering checks, and human review.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: Ambiguity remains visible when different readings would change the result.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: That restraint matters more than making every input produce a confident answer.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: SLEnglish is not tied to one mandatory reasoning engine or circuit runtime.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: Different compatible fragments may use rules, databases, solvers, simulations, or generated code.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: Each adapter must declare what it preserves, rejects, or approximates.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: A statistical estimate must not become indistinguishable from a deductive proof.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: The comparison chapters acknowledge what established standards and controlled languages already provide.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: The proposed layer must earn its place beside those existing capabilities.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: Reading those comparisons helps separate a useful interface from an unnecessary extra language.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: The application to science begins with a problem that rerunnable code does not settle.
